1345 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
03-19-1345 minus 102 days:  
March has 31 days, so back to March 1 is 18 days (19-1).  
Remaining days: 102 - 18 = 84 days earlier.  
February 1345 has 28 days, January has 31 days, December 1344 has 31 days.  
From March 1 back 28 days → Feb 1 (28 days).  
From Feb 1 back 31 days → Jan 1 (total 59 days).  
From Jan 1 back 25 days (since 84 - 59 = 25) → December 1344: Dec 1 back 25 days = Dec 7, 1344? Wait, careful:  

Better: Count days remaining after March 1: 84 days earlier.  
Go back through February (28 days) → reach Feb 1 (28 days), remaining 84-28=56 days.  
Go back through January (31 days) → reach Jan 1 (31 days), remaining 56-31=25 days.  
Go back into December 1344: December has 31 days, so Jan 1 minus 1 day = Dec 31, minus 25 more days = Dec 7, 1344.  

Check: Dec 7, 1344 to Mar 19, 1345:  
Dec 7–31: 24 days, Jan 31 days, Feb 28 days, Mar 19 days → 24+31+28+19 = 102 days. Correct.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1344-12-07
